title: Growth habit experiments — 12-week scratchbook
content:
Context:
- Personal scratchbook to turn vague 'grow as a people ops partner' goal into concrete weekly habits and micro-experiments. Not a polished plan — living notes.
- Timeline: 12 weeks (Q1-ish). Focus areas: influence, hiring calibration, coaching cadence, cross-team product empathy.

North star (what does success look like in 12w):
- Manager trust score + peer feedback improves (target +0.4 on internal pulse).
- Two recurring playbooks adopted by 2 engineering teams (interview rubric tweaks, calibrated debrief format).
- Weekly coaching slot leads to measurable change: at least 3 direct reports report a clear career action taken.

Top 5 micro-experiments (one-per-week patterns, can overlap):
1) 15-min pre-1:1 prep note template for managers (pilot with 3 managers).
   - Hypothesis: structured pre-work raises meeting clarity and follow-through.
   - Metrics: % of meetings with clear next step captured; manager survey after 3 weeks.
2) Two-question async career pulse (biweekly) sent to 8 directs.
   - Q1: "What's one stretch task you'd like next month?" Q2: "What's blocking that?"
   - Use to seed coaching topics.
3) Interview calibration quick-deck (1 pager) + 20-min drop-in for hiring panel.
   - Pilot with Product team.
4) "Micro-feedback" habit: request one specific positive and one improvement each week from managers after 1:1.
   - Track through shared spreadsheet (manual for now).
5) Office hours experiment: 4x30m open slots with rotating themes (career mapping, IC leveling, promotion checklist).

Weekly cadence & checkpoints (example weeks):
- Week 1: Draft the pre-1:1 template, test with manager Aisha (one meeting). Capture reactions.
- Week 2: Send first async career pulse to 8 people; analyze replies in 48h.
- Week 3: Build interview calibration 1-pager; run 20-min drop-in.
- Week 4: Trial micro-feedback habit with two managers; collect 1st-week raw notes.
- Week 5: Host first themed office hour (career mapping). Observe attendance and ask for NPS.
- Repeat iterate, widen pilots to more teams by week 7–9.

Measurement plan (lightweight):
- Manager trust proxy: quick 3-question pulse at start, week 6, week 12. Questions short, Likert 1–5.
- Adoption count: number of teams using a template/playbook at least twice.
- Evidence log: 1–3 short anecdotes per week (snippets).

Manager 1:1 prep (what I want to bring to my manager next time):
- Status: running 3 pilots, early signals show engagement (see evidence).
- Ask: support in getting Product EMs to commit to 2 calibration sessions (intro call + follow-up).
- Blockers: scheduling buy-in, need a 15-min intro slot in the Product all-hands or EM sync.
- Proposal: offer to run 15-min demo + share one-pager; ask manager to intro via Slack.
- Risks: perceived as extra process; will keep docs minimal and opt-in.

Evidence snippets (copy-paste raw):
- "Pre-1:1 template saved me 10m prepping; I left each 1:1 with 1 clear next step" — Manager J. (pilot 11/12)
- "Async pulse surfaced 2 folks wanting shadowing opportunities I wouldn't have surfaced otherwise" — reply excerpts 11/19

Quick scoreboard (still rough):
- Pilots active: 3
- Managers engaged: 5
- Direct replies to pulse: 6/8
- Office hour attendees: 7 (first session)

Retrospective notes to self (ongoing):
- Keep friction very low. If an artifact adds >3 extra minutes to someone's flow, it's dead.
- Incentivize managers with direct value: less rework in 1:1s, clearer follow-through.
- Build visible wins: capture and share 1 short quote per week.

Open questions & decisions to make:
- Do we try to productize the pre-1:1 template into a short Confluence template or keep it distributed? (leaning Confluence + copyable snippets).
- How much time to spend automating the feedback capture vs manual spreadsheet for the pilot? (manual until adoption > 3 teams).

To-do (next 2 weeks):
- [ ] Finalize pre-1:1 template V0 and send to two managers for trial.
- [ ] Schedule 20-min drop-in for Product hiring panel; share 1-pager.
- [ ] Send second async pulse and create a short summary doc with 3 themes.
- [ ] Pull first-week quotes and prepare 1 slide for upstream sync.

1:1 talking points (for next meeting with my manager):
- Progress on pilots (numbers + 1 quote).
- Ask for intro into Product EM sync and suggested phrasing.
- Resource ask: 2 hours of editorial help to create a polished 1-pager if pilots scale.
- Career note: interested in leading a cross-functional "calibration" effort next quarter; would like manager feedback on stretch readiness.

Notes to self (style reminders):
- Keep examples concrete. One-sentence anecdote beats abstract theory.
- Use minimal docs (1 pager or checklist).
- Treat this like an experiment: set short windows, clear success criteria, stop if not moving the needle.

End-of-scratchbook quick log (most recent):
- 2026-02-10: Pulse results show steady sentiment; managers flagged time as main friction. Plan: shorter template + optional prefill examples.
- 2026-02-12: Product EM intro confirmed for 2/19; scheduled 15-min demo.

--
Small archive notes: linking this into a longer-term "people-ops playbook" if two or more pilots show adoption. For now: keep messy, iterate fast.
